mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, content, reply, status, created_at, replied_at FROM feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT f.id, f.user_id, u.username, f.content, f.reply, f.status, f.created_at, f.replied_at FROM feedback f JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.user_id f.status = #{status} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET reply = #{reply}, status = 'REPLIED', replied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
